title: hogayi kazim pe jafa haye haye
body:
hogayi kazim pe jafa haaye haaye
zehr sitamgar ne diya haaye haaye
zeest me unko na rehai mili
mar ke hue shah reha haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
laash uthi shaah ki zindaan se
zulm ye bekas pa hua haaye haaye
laash ko rakkha pule baghdaad par
zulm ye haroo'n ne kiya haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
rehgayi begor musafir ki laash
ghuslo kafan tak na diya haaye haaye
